tags.name: Games
tags.description: Umbrella Game tier. Each game groups one or more Levels (each its own WASM bundle). Public — no authentication required.

tags.name: Controls
tags.description: Submit player input. Multiplayer: when X-Session-Id is supplied, every active session_member may write controls for the character they own. Legacy single-session path retained for non-multiplayer clients.

tags.name: Input events
tags.description: Generalised event ingestion (gamepad / mouse / keyboard / touch / audio / world / control).

tags.name: Admin debug mode
tags.description: Admin-only runtime toggles for diagnostics ingest. Default OFF; admins enable briefly while triaging.

tags.name: Game launches
tags.description: Mint a per-session URL-safe uid that gates the WASM bundle path.

tags.name: Diagnostics
tags.description: Forwarded WASM console lines. Admin-only and gated on the wasm-console debug-mode toggle.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Static asset delivery for the Godot WASM bundle and other game files. Public — no authentication required.

tags.name: Items
tags.description: Inventory and equipment management. Requires authentication.

tags.name: Characters
tags.description: Player character CRUD. Requires authentication. Stat patches broadcast a character SSE event to all subscribers.

tags.name: View egress
tags.description: Per-player camera/orientation samples streamed by the Rust GDExtension. Fans out on the per-session SSE view channel admins watch.

tags.name: Federation
tags.description: Runtime module-federation manifest, served from PostgreSQL.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Player session lifecycle — connect, claim controller, disconnect. Up to 3 concurrent players.

tags.name: Moderation
tags.description: Per-game moderator actions: stop a session, kick a player. ROLE_MOD or ROLE_ADMIN required, plus a mod_game_scopes row for the targeted session's game.

tags.name: Game access
tags.description: Admin-only: who can see which game (all / role / individual user).

tags.name: Admin role grants
tags.description: Admin-only management of per-game mod and publisher scopes. Casdoor owns role membership; these tables own the per-game scope.

tags.name: Multiplayer sessions
tags.description: Named multiplayer sessions — create, list, join, leave, close. Hot-path controls fan out via per-session SSE sinks; subscribers of one session never see another session's events.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: Skill catalogue and per-character learned skills / hotbar slots. Requires authentication.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication proxy. Exchanges credentials for a Casdoor JWT without exposing client_secret to the browser.

tags.name: Admin session stream
tags.description: Per-session SSE merge for admin observation. Movement / world / character / view, scoped to one session id.

tags.name: Levels
tags.description: Individual playable levels — each level is its own compiled Godot WASM bundle served from /api/assets/levels/{slug}/.

tags.name: Game Time
tags.description: In-game clock. One game-minute elapses every ~10 real seconds. The full cycle advances and persists automatically.

tags.name: Quests
tags.description: Quest catalogue and per-character progress. Requires authentication.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Admin-only proxy for the Casdoor role catalog.

tags.name: Game uploads
tags.description: Admin-only: install a Godot bundle zip + run register.sql.

tags.name: Game Stream
tags.description: Multiplexed SSE stream delivering all real-time game events on a single connection.

tags.name: Session logs
tags.description: Session participation history per user.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Server-management endpoints. Requires ROLE_ADMIN (isAdmin claim in JWT).

tags.name: Chapter Assets
tags.description: Registry for user-added Godot assets (textures, plugins, sounds) attached to a specific level. Served via /api/assets/levels/.

tags.name: Friends
tags.description: Friend graph + blocklist for the authenticated player.

tags.name: Publisher
tags.description: Per-game publisher actions: list owned games, grant / revoke the mod role for those games. Admins bypass scope checks.

tags.name: Admin actions
tags.description: Moderator-driven kick / ban / unban surface. Writes append-only rows to admin_actions and broadcasts a live event so the targeted player's tabs close their game window immediately.

put.summary: Assign skill to a hotbar slot
put.description:
Sets `skillId` on the given slot number. Slot must already exist (created
during character setup). Pass `skillId` as a query param.

```
──request──► slotRepo.findByCharacterIdAndSlotNumber(charId, slot)
                   │
         ┌─────────┴──────────┐
         │ found              │ empty
         ▼                    ▼
  setSkillId(skillId)   switchIfEmpty(404)
  slotRepo.save()             ──✗
         │
  ──────●─|  (empty body)
```

put.summary: Equip an item to a slot
put.description:
Sets `itemId` on an existing equipment slot. Slot must already exist.
Pass `itemId` as a query param.

```
──request──► equipRepo.findByCharacterIdAndSlot(charId, slot)
                   │
         ┌─────────┴──────────┐
         │ found              │ empty
         ▼                    ▼
  setItemId(itemId)     switchIfEmpty(404)
  equipRepo.save()            ──✗
         │
  ──────●─|  (empty body)
```

get.description:
```
──request──► characterRepo.findById(id)
                   │

```

put.description:
Applies a partial update to the character. Any subset of stat fields may be
included. After save, broadcasts a `character` SSE event so all connected
clients see the updated HP/MP/level immediately.

Accepted patch keys: `currentHp`, `currentMp`, `maxHp`, `maxMp`, `level`,
`xp`, `xpToNext`, `attack`, `defense`, `speed`, `magicPower`, `currentChapterId`.

```
──request──► characterRepo.findById(id)
              ──●──► map(applyPatch)
                      ──●──► characterRepo.save()
                              ──●──► gameStateService
                                     .notifyCharacterStatChange()
                                     (emits character$ SSE event)
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────●─|
                                              CharacterDto (updated)
```

put.summary: Mark a quest complete for this character
put.description:
Sets `character_quests.status = 'completed'` and `completed_at = NOW()`
for the given character+quest pair. Completing the last prerequisite
quest unlocks the next level(s) for that character.

```
──request──► charQuests.findByCharacterIdAndQuestId(charId, questId)
                   │
         ┌─────────┴──────────┐
         │ found              │ empty
         ▼                    ▼
  status='completed'     switchIfEmpty(404)
  completedAt=NOW()            ──✗
  charQuests.save()
         │
  ──────●─|  CharacterQuest (updated)
```

Flip the wasm-console diagnostics gate. When `enabled=false`
(the default), every POST to `/api/diagnostics/wasm-console`
is refused with *403* and no captured browser-side errors
are persisted or fanned out on the SSE channel.

Same patch pipeline as the player endpoint but without ownership checks.
Useful for seeding stats or correcting corrupted values.

Accepted patch keys: `level`, `xp`, `xpToNext`, `maxHp`, `currentHp`,
`maxMp`, `currentMp`, `attack`, `defense`, `speed`, `magicPower`.

```
──request──► characterRepo.findById(id)
                   │
         ┌─────────┴──────────┐
         │ found              │ empty
         ▼                    ▼
  map(applyPatch)       switchIfEmpty(404)
  characterRepo.save()        ──✗
         │
  ──────●─|  CharacterDto (updated)
```

post.summary: Submit a player-view sample
post.description:
Authorizes the caller as the active member who owns
`characterId` for `sessionId`, then fans out the sample on
the per-session view SSE channel. The JWT subject must match
the `session_members.casdoor_id` of the active row owning
`characterId`; otherwise *403*.

```
──request──► sessions.authorizeControl(sub, characterId)
              ──●──► gameState.emitView(PlayerViewEvent)
                 ──●─| 202 Accepted
```

get.description:
Returns every session whose `closed_at IS NULL`, optionally filtered
by `gameSlug`. The home-page session-picker calls this with the
game's slug after the player clicks a game card.

parameters.name: gameSlug
parameters.description: Filter to one game's slug. Omit to list all open sessions.

post.summary: Create a new multiplayer session
post.description:
Mints a UUID, persists a `game_sessions` row plus a `session_members`
row for the caller (flagged as creator), and returns the session DTO.
The caller is auto-joined; the session shows up in the open-sessions
list for `gameSlug` immediately.

```
──request──► sessions.save(GameSession)
              ──●──► members.save(SessionMember{is_creator=true})
                 ──●─| GameSessionDto{id, name, members:[creator]}
```

post.summary: Join a session
post.description:
Idempotent on (sessionId, casdoorId): rejoining as the same caller
updates the existing membership row (slot / character) instead of
creating a duplicate. Slot collisions resolve as 409 Conflict via
the `uq_session_members_active_slot` partial unique index.

post.summary: Claim the controller role
post.description:
Attempts to acquire the exclusive controller role. Only one player at a time
may hold it. Succeeds if no other session currently has `is_controller = true`.

```
──request──► sessionRepo.countByIsControllerTrue()
                   │
         ┌─────────┴──────────┐
         │ count = 0          │ count ≥ 1
         ▼                    ▼
  setController(true)    ────────────────●─|
         │                {granted: false}
  ────────────────────────●─|
  {granted: true}
```

post.summary: Connect and receive a session token
post.description:
Creates or resumes a player session. The first player to connect is
automatically granted the controller role. Rejects a fourth connection.

```
──request──► sessionRepo.countActiveSessions()
                   │
         ┌─────────┴──────────┐
         │ count < 3          │ count = 3
         ▼                    ▼
  createOrResumeSession()  ──✗  409 Conflict
  (1st caller auto-claims
   controller role)
         │
  ────────────────────────●─|
    {sessionToken, isController, activePlayers}
```

post.summary: Stop (force-close) a session
post.description:
Authorizes the caller as a mod for the session's game_slug,
then sets `closed_at = NOW()` on the session. Audited in
`admin_actions` with `[stop-session sessionId=...]` in the
message column.

post.summary: Kick a single player from a session
post.description:
Stamps `left_at` on the target's session_members row. If they
were the last active member, the session auto-closes. Audited
in `admin_actions`.

post.summary: Submit an input event.
post.description:
One endpoint, discriminated payload. The (kind, type) pair
picks a schema. The BFF rejects with 400 if the (kind, type)
is unknown, and with 405 if the game's games.features flag
for the event kind is false or absent, or (for events such
as control:cast) the subsystem flag the event belongs to is.
Otherwise it persists into input_events and fans out on the
SSE input + audio channels.

The endpoint is authenticated. The Casdoor user id is
read from the JWT subject; the body's casdoorUserId field
is ignored if present.

post.summary: Launch a game session
post.description:
Mints a 256-bit URL-safe uid the federated remote uses as the
path component when loading the WASM bundle. The BFF persists
the launch + TTL; the AssetController validates incoming
asset requests against this table.

Auth: the principal's roles + user id must match a row in
`game_access` for this game (else 403). The catalog filter
already hides forbidden games from the home grid, but this
endpoint enforces the check independently — defence in depth.

post.summary: Forward one WASM console line to the SSE wasm-console channel.
post.description:
Requires `SCOPE_ROLE_ADMIN`. Additionally requires
`wasm_console_debug_enabled = true` (admin flips at
`PUT /api/admin/debug-mode/wasm-console`). Both gates must
pass; otherwise *403*.

post.summary: Submit a control event
post.description:
Two authorization modes — pick by whether `X-Session-Id` is present.

**Multiplayer mode** (X-Session-Id supplied). Every active
`session_members` row may concurrently POST controls for the
character they own; the JWT subject must match the row's
`casdoor_id`. The control fans out on the per-session SSE sinks
so subscribers of `/api/game/stream?sessionId=X` see only their
session's updates. Returns *403* if the caller is not the
session_member who owns `characterId`.

**Legacy single-session mode** (no X-Session-Id). The caller
must hold the global controller role checked by
`SessionService.isController(casdoorId)`. Three-wizards
cave/field single-player retains this path.

```
──request + X-Session-Id?──►
              │
    yes ──► gameSessionService.authorizeControl(jwt.sub, characterId)
              │ ok    │ no
              ▼       ▼
    applyControl    403
    (event, cid, sid)
              │
    no  ──► sessionService.isController(jwt.sub)
              │ true  │ false
              ▼       ▼
    applyControl    403
    (event, cid)
```

**Body**

| field | type | example |
|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | `MOVE_FORWARD`, `JUMP`, `CAST_INSTANT_1` |
| `pressed` | boolean | `true` = key-down, `false` = key-up |
| `timestamp` | long | client epoch-ms |
| `chapterId` | long? | optional — explicit chapter the move applies to |

parameters.name: X-Session-Id
parameters.description: Multiplayer session id. When present, authz uses session_members ownership instead of the global single-session controller role.

parameters.name: X-Casdoor-Id
parameters.description: Legacy fallback — Casdoor user subject. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <jwt>; this header is only honoured when no JWT is present.

post.summary: Use the character's first inventory item (E key / quick slot)
post.description:
Looks up the lowest-id item in `character_items` for this character,
applies its effect (heal HP / restore MP / cure status), and decrements
the quantity. Returns the updated character snapshot so the HUD reflects
the new HP/MP. If the inventory is empty or the only items are
non-consumable (weapons, armor), returns 404.

```
──request──► charItems.findByCharacterId(id)
              ──filter qty>0, sort by id ──first──►
                itemRepo.findById(item)
                  ──apply effect──► characters.save()
                  ──decrement quantity──► charItems.save()
 ──────────────────────────────────────●─|  CharacterDto
```

post.summary: Exchange credentials for an access token
post.description:
Proxies an OAuth2 Resource Owner Password Credentials grant to Casdoor.
The `client_secret` is injected server-side — it is never sent to the browser.
The returned `access_token` is a signed RS256 JWT; store it in `sessionStorage`
and attach it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on subsequent API requests.

```
Browser                  API (:8080)                 Casdoor (:8000, internal)
  │                         │                               │
  │  POST /api/auth/token   │                               │
  │  {username, password}   │                               │
  │────────────────────────►│                               │
  │                         │  POST /api/login/oauth/       │
  │                         │       access_token            │
  │                         │  grant_type=password          │
  │                         │  client_id=…                  │
  │                         │  client_secret=…  (server)    │
  │                         │  username=…  password=…       │
  │                         │───────────────────────────────►
  │                         │                               │
  │                         │◄─── {access_token, …} ────────│
  │                         │                               │
  │◄────────────────────────│
  │  {access_token,         │
  │   token_type,           │
  │   expires_in}           │

Reactor chain:
Mono.just(req)
 ──●──► WebClient.post(casdoor, form)
         .retrieve()
         .bodyToMono(Map)
 ──────────────────────────●─|
                            {access_token, token_type, expires_in, id_token}
```

Store and use the token:
```js
const { access_token, expires_in } = await authService.login(u, p);
// AuthService stores to sessionStorage; HTTP interceptor attaches Bearer automatically
```

get.summary: Subscribe to the multiplexed SSE game stream
get.description:
Returns a never-ending `text/event-stream`. Five reactive sources are merged
into one connection; distinguish them with the SSE `event:` field.

```
movement$  ──●──────────────────●────────●──⋯  position / action changed
world$     ──●──●──●──●──●──●──●──●──●──●──⋯  heartbeat  (1 s)
character$ ────────────●────────────────────⋯  HP/MP/XP/level changed
time$      ─────────────────────●────────────⋯  game clock (every ~10 s real)
scene$     ──●──────────────────────────────⋯  scene transition
keepalive  ─────────────────────────────────⋯  comment    (30 s)

merged:    ──●──●──●──●──●──●──●──●──●──●──⋯
              ServerSentEvent<Object>
```

**Event payloads**

| event | key fields |
|---|---|
| `movement` | `x`, `y`, `z`, `rotationY`, `action`, `pressed` |
| `world` | `sessionId`, `tick`, `timestamp` |
| `character` | `health`, `mana`, `level`, `xp`, `xpToNext` |
| `time` | `dayNumber`, `hour`, `minute` |
| `scene` | `sceneId`, `sceneName`, `sceneType` |

Connect with `EventSource` and register a listener per event type:
```js
const es = new EventSource('/api/game/stream');

                   │
         ┌─────────┴──────────┐

  ──────●─|                   ──✗  404

get.summary: Serve a level-scoped asset, gated on a launch uid
get.description:
The federated remote calls `POST /api/games/{slug}/launch` to
mint a per-session uid, then loads its WASM bundle from this
endpoint. The BFF resolves the uid in `game_launches` and
confirms it (a) hasn't been terminated, (b) is still within
its TTL, and (c) was issued for this exact game slug — so a
valid uid for game X can't be repurposed to fetch game Y's
assets. Mismatches return 404 (not 403) so an attacker can't
tell whether a uid exists.

get.summary: Serve a level-scoped asset (legacy path, no launch UID)
get.description:
Legacy path that does NOT require a launch uid. Kept while the
iframe-based SPA is still in production; the federated remote
uses the {uid}-suffixed variant below. Flip
`app.assets.require-launch-uid=true` in application.yml to make
this path 403, forcing all consumers onto the gated path.

get.summary: Live admin SSE stream — active sessions, players, stats every 5 s
get.description:
Pushes the admin dashboard's live numbers continuously instead of
requiring `/api/admin/stats` polling. Each tick emits one event per
type so the dashboard can register `addEventListener` per channel.

```
connect ─►  Flux.interval(0, 5s)
             ──tick──tick──tick──⋯
                │
            per-tick: zip(
                sessionService.computeStats(),
                sessionService.activeSessions().collectList(),
                characterRepo.findAll().collectList())
                │
              three SSE events:
                event: stats     {AdminStatsDto}
                event: sessions  [SessionDto…]
                event: roster    [CharacterDto…]
```

Cassandra-backed cross-pod synchronisation means even when the API
scales horizontally the per-tick snapshot reflects every pod's
session map, not just the one this request hit.

and online status so admins can see all users without loading any game.

               sessionRepo.findAll().collectList(),
               characterRepo.count())
           ──map──► derive:
                      totalUsers, totalSessions, currentlyActive,
                      averageSessionMinutes, totalCharacters,
                      perUser:[{casdoorId, characterName,
                                sessionCount, totalMinutes, online}]
 ──────────────────────●─|
                        AdminStatsDto
```

get.summary: Subscribe to one session's merged SSE stream
get.description:
Returns a never-ending `text/event-stream` carrying every event
that the session's members produce — movement, world, character
stat changes, and per-slot view samples. Subscribers of session
A never see session B's events; the per-session sinks are
isolated by construction.

```
movement(sessionA)$ ──●──●──●──●──⋯
world(sessionA)$    ────●──────●──⋯
character(sessionA)$──────●────────⋯
view(sessionA)$     ──●●●●●●●●●●●●●⋯  (~10 Hz per slot)
keepalive           ──────────────⋯  (15 s)

merged: ──●──●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●⋯
           ServerSentEvent<Object>
```

**Event payloads**

| event | key fields |
|---|---|
| `movement` | `characterId`, `chapterId`, `x/y/z`, `action`, `pressed`, `tick` |
| `world` | `chapterId`, `roster: PlayerMovement[]`, `tick` |
| `character` | `characterId`, `hp`, `mp`, `xp`, status flags |
| `view` | `slotIndex`, `characterId`, `x/y/z`, `yaw/pitch/fov`, `occurredAt` |

```js
const es = new EventSource('/api/admin/sessions/' + sessionId + '/stream');
es.addEventListener('view', e => { /* render frustum hint */ });
```

endpoint never caches, never persists.

delete.description:
Stamps `left_at` on the caller's active membership row. Idempotent:
calling twice is a no-op. If the caller was the last active member,
the session itself is auto-closed.

Removes the caller's session. If they held the controller role,
it becomes available for another player to claim.

```
──request──► sessionRepo.deleteByCasdoorId(sub)
 ──────────────────────────────────────●─|  (empty body)
```

Lets an admin terminate a launch the player owns — useful for kicking
stuck sessions, locking out a compromised token, or reclaiming a
launch slot after a crash. Differs from `DELETE /api/games/launches/{uid}`
(the player-side terminate) only in that the ownership check is skipped.

Force-removes a player's session regardless of controller status.
If the kicked player held the controller role it becomes claimable.

```
──request──► sessionRepo.deleteByCasdoorId(casdoorId)
 ──────────────────────────────────────●─|  (empty body)
```
